annotations.title: Bring a picture into the film

description: Fetches a picture from a web address into the person's storage and puts it on the video under a name the film finds it by. rights says why the film may use it: "licensed" for one from find_pictures (pass its credit line word for word; it is kept with the picture, and a licence that asks for credit means the credit goes in the captions or an end card), or "own" for a picture the person owns or has the rights to (their own site, their product, a picture they said is theirs). Nothing else may be fetched. PNG, JPG or WebP up to 10 MB, public addresses only. cutout: true then cuts its background away (a few credits); free otherwise. Returns a sheet of the video's pictures.

credit.description: The credit line from find_pictures, word for word; empty for the person's own picture

cutout.description: true cuts its background away and trims it, to move like a paper puppet (a few credits)

name.description: The name the film finds the picture by

note.description: What it shows, for the sheet and the library

rights.description: licensed: found with find_pictures; own: the person owns it or has the rights

url.description: The picture's own address (from find_pictures, or a picture of theirs)
